title: fix(github-tool): version the published tool by its contents
body:
Closes [CL-XXXX](https://linear.app/abklabs/issue/CL-XXXX)

## What changed

- `packTool` publishes the GitHub tool as `<package.json version>-sha-<8 hex>`, hashed over its manifest and bundle, instead of the hand-set package.json version. A tool change no longer collides with an already-published version.
- The hashing moved into a shared `contentVersion` helper in `tooling/pack-tarball.ts`, used by both the tool and the workflows.
- Workflow manifests depend on the packed tool's version, so a tool change also changes the workflow versions and the portal redeploys them.

## Verification

- `bun run check`, `bun run test` (690 pass).
- Packed twice: identical filenames (`@corbits-github-tool-0.7.2-sha-3ffe4ff5.tgz`, workflows `0.1.0-sha-d6d73747` / `0.1.0-sha-ac77366f`); the pr-triage manifest depends on `0.7.2-sha-3ffe4ff5`.
- Added an export to the tool and repacked: tool became `0.7.2-sha-a18d5f6e` and both workflow versions changed, so a registry holding `0.7.2` gets a new tarball and `ensureWorkflows` redeploys.
